# Empty search — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for empty search when the query found nothing and the reader needs a way back. `query` is required because the block always says what found nothing — the title echoes it, so the state is named rather than silent. `onClear` is the recovery: clearing returns to browsing everything. It is the recovery for one search only; there is no results list here, because the search above owns the results. `title`, `description` and `clearLabel` override the default English strings, and `suggestions` slots follow-up content like recent searches beneath the recovery action.

## Native

### Features

Reach for empty search when the query found nothing and the reader needs a way back — the native twin under the same contract. `query` is required because the block always says what found nothing — the title defaults to naming it, so the state is announced rather than silent. `onClear` is the recovery: clearing returns to browsing everything. It is the recovery for one search only; there is no results list here, because the search above owns the results. `title`, `description` and `clearLabel` override the default English strings, and `suggestions` slots follow-up content like recent searches beneath the recovery action.
